inputs.name: ticks

facts.text: OctoMuscleCrawl-v0 registers the environment gym_softrobot.envs.octopus:OctoMuscleCrawlEnv
The default configuration has 8 arms
OctopusMuscleConfig sets n_channels to 9
The action space is a Box from -1.0 to 1.0 with shape (n_arms, n_channels)
The observation space is a Box with shape (6,)
The observation is the central body's displacement from its reset pose (3 values) followed by its translational velocity (3 values)
One step advances the simulation by one control interval, control_dt
The default control interval control_dt is 1/60 s
The default horizon is the number of control intervals in episode_duration_s
The default episode duration is five cycles of T_L = 2.4 s, 12 s
The default episode is 720 steps at 60 Hz
The per-step reward is forward progress along -z divided by base_length minus lateral_penalty times the absolute lateral deviation divided by base_length
base_length is 0.45 m
lateral_penalty is 0.5
A non-finite simulation sets terminated and reaching the horizon sets truncated
reset(seed) seeds the environment random generator and returns the observation with an info dict that reports time
The simulation uses the Position Verlet integrator
The default physics timestep is 3.0e-4 s
The robot is a rigid central sphere of radius 0.09 m with arms of length 0.45 m, base radius 0.02 m and 15 elements
Gravity acts in the negative y direction with -9.80665 m/s^2
Rod-rod contact is disabled by default
The environment supports an rgb_array render mode

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 reseeds the fake's Python random.Random; the fake then integrates deterministically.  The upstream environment uses numpy's generator, so the same seed does not reproduce the same trajectory across the two implementations

gaps: F0 kinematic/analytic surrogate: the fake integrates a point-mass central body with a hand-written force map; there are no Cosserat rods, no PyElastica or COOMM, and no contact, friction, suction or muscle dynamics, so forces and contacts are not modelled
the action-to-force map is test data: the nine channels are not the TM/LM/OM muscle groups and the two suction bands of the upstream model
the six-value observation is the surrogate body's displacement and velocity, not the elastica sphere pose; arm shape, muscle activation and suction state are not modelled

the fake was not compared with the upstream environment: gym_softrobot needs gymnasium, numpy, PyElastica and COOMM (pyproject.toml:20-29) and was not importable where the gate ran; the sim backend was not run
the fake does not render: render() returns None, while the upstream rgb_array renderer needs matplotlib
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, only steps advance simulated time by timestep_ms

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step, reset or seed is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
